No entry offer

Readers leave without a trace

Someone who saves your recipes or watches your reels but isn't ready for 1:1 has nothing to join or buy. You can't follow up with people you never captured.

Middle step closed

Interest waits on a list

Group coaching is the natural next step for women who want support at a lower commitment, but it's "coming soon". Until it opens, that demand earns nothing.

No filter

Every consult is free and unscreened

Anyone can book the free call, so your team's time goes on people who may not be ready or able to start, and there's no way to tell them apart in advance.

Anyone not ready for 1:1 coaching today leaves with nothing, and the calls you do take aren't pre-qualified.

Who this class is for

For women who want food to feel simple again

  • Women who'd like to choose meals without checking an app or a rulebook first.

Meet Marissa

Hi, I'm Marissa Karp, RD

My message is simple: stop dieting, start living. This class is where that starts.

Questions

Before you grab your seat

Is this a diet?

No. There's no meal plan, no counting and no foods off limits. It's about how you think about food, not a new set of rules.

What if I can't make it live?

Your seat includes the replay, so you can watch when it suits you.

Is this medical advice?

No. This is an educational class. It isn't medical advice and doesn't replace individual care from your own healthcare provider.

Why is it only $17?

Because the first step should be easy. Come, learn, and decide afterwards if you'd like more support.

Script 1 · "The rulebook"

Hook (0 to 3s)

"As a dietitian, here's why food rules so rarely stick."

Body

"Rules tend to keep food on the mind. The stricter the list, the louder food gets. What helps instead is learning to listen to your own hunger and building meals that actually satisfy. It's a skill, and it can be learned."

CTA

"I'm teaching it live in a 60-minute masterclass. It's $17 and the replay is included. Tap Sign up to save your seat."

Shot: talking to camera in your kitchen, lemon bowl in frame. On-screen text: "Educational content, not medical advice."

Script 2 · "Two kinds of hunger"

Hook (0 to 3s)

"Not every hunger is the same hunger."

Body

"There's physical hunger, and there's the 'long day, I deserve something' kind. Both are normal. The difference is knowing which one is talking, so you can choose what you actually want. I use a simple check-in for it."

CTA

"I'll walk through it live in Stop Dieting, Start Living. 60 minutes, $17. Tap Sign up."

Shot: talking to camera, cut to a simple 1 to 10 hunger scale graphic in sage and lemon.

Script 3 · "Eating out"

Hook (0 to 3s)

"What I wish more women knew about eating out."

Body

"One meal out doesn't need a plan for the next three days. Order what sounds good, eat slowly enough to enjoy it, and move on. That's not a lack of discipline. That's a healthy relationship with food."

CTA

"Want more of this? Join my live masterclass. Seats are $17, replay included. Tap Sign up below."

Shot: walking to camera on a NYC street, then sitting at a restaurant table.
